title: Centered Ablation: Why Last-Layer Directional Ablation Under-Fires or Collapses, and a Closed-Form Fix
abstract: arXiv:2611.20148v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Directional ablation removes a hidden state's component along a "behaviour direction" while a language model runs. It is the standard way to switch a behaviour such as refusal off, but it is erratic: on some models it barely fires, on others the text collapses into repetition. We show why, and fix it. At the last residual stream, ablation is exactly a logit bias: a fixed vocabulary footprint scaled by a gate, the cosine between the hidden state and the direction. The gate is measured from the origin, but last-layer states share a large common mode far from it, so a direction that overlaps the common mode fires on benign text and under-fires on its targets. Centered Ablation (CA) projects the common mode out of the direction, in closed form. Across 8 models, CA raises attack success by 29 and 46 points where the standard recipe under-fires, cuts collapse on Gemma-2-9B from 50\% to 1\%, and preserves 12 to 40 points more benign answers on

translated_title: 中心化消融：为什么最后一层的方向消融会触发不足或崩溃，以及一个闭式修复方法
translated_abstract: 方向消融在语言模型运行时移除隐藏状态沿“行为方向”的分量。它是关闭某种行为（如拒答）的标准方法，但其表现不稳定：在某些模型上几乎不生效，而在另一些模型上文本则崩溃为重复。我们解释了原因，并给出了修复方案。在最后一个残差流层上，消融恰好等价于一个逻辑偏置：一个固定的词表足迹乘以一个门控系数——即隐藏状态与方向之间的余弦值。该门控是从原点测量的，但最后一层的隐藏状态共享一个远离原点的大共模分量，因此与共模重叠的方向会在良性文本上触发，而在其目标上触发不足。中心化消融以闭式形式将共模从方向中投影出去。在8个模型上，CA 在标准方法触发不足的情况下将攻击成功率提升了29和46个百分点，将 Gemma-2-9B 上的崩溃率从50%降至1%，并在……上多保留了12到40个百分点的良性回答（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 论文揭示了方向消融不稳定的根源——最后一层隐藏状态包含远离原点的大共模分量导致门控系数失准，并提出闭式的中心化消融（CA）方法，通过投影去除共模，在8个模型上大幅提升攻击成功率、将文本崩溃率从50%降至1%并保留更多良性回答。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that directional ablation's erratic behavior stems from last-layer hidden states sharing a large common mode far from the origin, which miscalibrates the ablation gate, and introduces Centered Ablation (CA), a closed-form fix that projects out this common mode—raising attack success by 29-46 points where standard ablation under-fires, cutting collapse on Gemma-2-9B from 50% to 1%, and preserving 12-40 points more benign answers across 8 models.
